answer: The registry makes its audit river run uphill, so the k-th identity one attester vouches for faces k random audits in its first epoch, each demanding live proof of fresh work from a new auditor and billing $10 of auditor time, while the attester locks $500 in the registry vault, forfeited on any failed audit. One attester's identities stand as one dune, so forging 1,000 puppets through one attester means surviving 1+2+…+1000 = 500,500 audits, $5,005,000, puppet 1,000 alone costing $10,000; splitting costs a fresh $500 bond per attester. An honest agent faces one audit, $10, once.
